name: Individual or business holder lacks economic link to deposit areas
description: Account holder profile shows no business or family ties in places where deposits occur.
fp: Customers may be mobile or have remote clients.

sources.text: FATF, Money Laundering through the Physical Transportation of Cash (2015)
FFIEC, BSA/AML Examination Manual (FinCEN is not publisher)
